# LinkedIn Post

A community: self-promotion is judged by tone and by whether you are a real member.

Notes from the directory list: Founder story post.

## Steps
1. Open https://www.linkedin.com/feed/ and read the rules (sidebar, wiki, FAQ or guidelines).
2. Write a post for this specific audience from `copy.reddit_post` / `copy.launch_post_story`, following skill/human-writing.
3. `launchkit draft linkedin-post -` with title, body, flair and best posting time, then `launchkit mark linkedin-post drafted`.
4. Only if `launch_settings.allow_social_posting` is true and the user approved this draft: post it, then mark `submitted --listing-url <post url>`.

## Make the listing perform
- Read the rules first. Draft for approval (mode post) unless the user enabled posting.
